abstract: CONTEXT: Struma ovarii exhibiting malignant histology are uncommon, and an aggressive clinical course in the form of initial extraovarian spread or recurrence is even more exceptional for these tumors. OBJECTIVE: To determine whether specific histologic features have predictive value in distinguishing clinically benign from clinically malignant struma ovarii. DESIGN: Blinded analysis of 19 histologic characteristics of thyroid tumors was performed in 60 clinically benign and 26 clinically malignant struma ovarii cases, with long-term follow-up. RESULTS: Except for lack of fibrosis and macrofollicular pattern, which were more common in biologically malignant tumors (P = .04 and P = .008, respectively), and trabecular pattern, which was associated with a benign clinical course (P = .03), none of the other histologic features was found to be correlated with clinical behavior. The presence of the following features was similar in the biologically benign and malignant tumors: papillae, pseudo-papillae, psammoma bodies, nuclear grooves, nuclear overlap, "orphan Annie" nuclei, nuclear pseudo-inclusions, prominent nucleoli, hypercellularity, colloid scalloping, eosinophilic cytoplasm, mitoses, vascular invasion, cytologic atypia, nuclear pleomorphism, and cell size and type. Trabecular pattern and absence of fibrosis were uncommon, and there was considerable overlap of macrofollicular pattern ratio between benign and malignant cases. Thus, their practical usefulness is uncertain. CONCLUSIONS: The clinical outcome of struma ovarii cannot be predicted based on the microscopic diagnosis of the thyroid tissue or on specific histologic features. The lack of correlation between morphology and outcome in proliferative and histologically malignant struma ovarii is striking, making the behavior of these tumors particularly unpredictable.
abstract_ja:
背景：卵巣甲状腺腫で悪性の組織像を示すものはまれであり、初発時の卵巣外進展や再発といった攻撃的な臨床経過はさらに例外的です。

目的：特定の組織学的特徴が、臨床的に良性の卵巣甲状腺腫と臨床的に悪性の卵巣甲状腺腫を区別する予測価値を持つかどうかを明らかにすることです。

デザイン：甲状腺腫瘍の19の組織学的特徴について、ブラインド解析を行いました。対象は臨床的に良性の60例と臨床的に悪性の26例の卵巣甲状腺腫で、長期フォローアップを行っています。

結果：線維化の欠如と巨大濾胞パターンは、生物学的に悪性の腫瘍でより多くみられ（P=.04、P=.008）、索状パターンは良性の臨床経過と関連していました（P=.03）。その他の組織学的特徴は、生物学的に良性の腫瘍と悪性の腫瘍で同程度にみられました。索状パターンおよび線維化の欠如はまれであり、巨大濾胞パターンの割合は良性例と悪性例で大きく重なっていました。したがって、それらの実用性は不確かです。

結論：卵巣甲状腺腫の臨床転帰は、甲状腺組織の顕微鏡的診断や特定の組織学的特徴から予測することはできません。増殖性で組織学的に悪性の卵巣甲状腺腫において形態と転帰の相関がみられないことは顕著であり、これらの腫瘍の挙動は特に予測困難です。
